value.title: Chi Goes West.
value.synopsis: The Yamada family talks about whether they should send Chi to Juri in Hokkaido or not.

value.title: Chi is Taken Away
value.synopsis: Dad dreams that Chi is taken away to Hokkaido by Juri.

value.title: Chi Runs Away From Home
value.synopsis: Youhei overhears Mom and Dad talking about sending Chi away and runs away with her. Chi runs from Youhei when he is talking with his parents in the park and chases a bird.

value.title: Chi Decides Again
value.synopsis: Chi comes back to the family, and they decide that instead of sending her away, they will move to a house where pets are allowed.

value.title: Chi Prepares
value.synopsis: The Yamada family packs their belongings while Chi is trapped in a box without their knowing.

value.title: Chi Imagines
value.synopsis: Chi is isolated in the bathroom while the movers take the boxes and imagines all the bad things the noises would be.

value.title: Chi Reminisced
value.synopsis: Chi comes out of the bathroom and goes to new home with the Yamada family.

value.title: Chi Moves
value.synopsis: The Yamada family takes Chi to the new home, but Chi does not want to come out of the box, thinking it is the animal hospital.

value.title: Chi Sniffs Around
value.synopsis: While Chi is in the new home, she picks up strange smells around the house. She wants to return to the old house.

value.title: Chi, Goes Exploring.
value.synopsis: Chi makes everything in her new home smell like her.

value.title: Chi has an idea
value.synopsis: Chi figures out how to use the kitty-door.

value.title: Chi Greets - Part 1
value.synopsis: Chi and the Yamadas visit their new neighbors, Akashi who owns a parakeet, Lucky, and Furukawa who owns a rabbit, Mi-chan.

value.title: Chi Greets - Part 2
value.synopsis: Chi and the Yamadas continue to meet their new neighbors, including a woman named Ijyuin with a golden long-haired cat named Alice.

value.title: Chi Challenges
value.synopsis: Chi and the Yamadas meet their next-door neighbor, Kusano Yuki with a dog, David.

value.title: Chi goes into the Garden
value.synopsis: Chi finally goes outside to her new backyard.

value.title: Chi Retaliates
value.synopsis: Chi isn't happy with the dog David from next door, but discovers that David can't come in her backyard.

value.title: Chi Welcomes
value.synopsis: Chi's neighbor Alice comes into her home.

value.title: Chi Plays
value.synopsis: Chi chases a butterfly and goes into the Kusano's yard.

value.title: Chi Goes Outside
value.synopsis: Chi discovers the outside of her yard.

value.title: Chi is Excited
value.synopsis: Chi follows other cats and wanders away from home.

value.title: Chi Returns
value.synopsis: Chi goes back to her old home but notices something and wonders where her home is.

value.title: Chi Is Invited
value.synopsis: Chi meets an orange, black and white cat named Mike and is invited to his house. He asks Chi if she wants to stay at his place instead.

value.title: Chi Leaves Footprints
value.synopsis: Chi comes back from outside and leaves pawprints everywhere at home.

value.title: Chi is Stopped
value.synopsis: Chi is stopped by the Yamadas from touching many things.

value.title: Chi Gets Mad
value.synopsis: Youhei invites his friends Mayu and Ryu, and introduces Chi. However, Ryu is scared of cats.

value.title: Chi Makes Up
value.synopsis: Chi gets angered by Ryu, and Youhei's friends tries to make up for Chi.

value.title: Chi Gets Adored
value.synopsis: Chi meets the pet store lady and she falls in love with Chi.

value.title: Chi Gets Chased
value.synopsis: Chi is followed by the pet store lady and loses her. Mr. Yamada brags about Chi to the pet store lady.

value.title: Chi Gets Carried
value.synopsis: Chi is carried in a kitty bag and Mr. Yamada comes to the pet store again to bet who is the cutest cat.

value.title: Chi Runs Around
value.synopsis: Chi meets the pet store lady again and escapes from her.

value.title: Chi Is Kept Waiting
value.synopsis: Chi visits the Furukawas, sees Mi-chan the rabbit, and waits.

value.title: Chi Mimics
value.synopsis: Chi visits the Akashi thinking that Lucky is food but Lucky impersonates Chi.

value.title: Chi Cuts Through
value.synopsis: Chi likes to go through things.

value.title: Chi Can`t Sleep
value.synopsis: Chi tries to sleep, and then plays.

value.title: Chi Makes Sure
value.synopsis: Youhei gets his birthday present and Chi likes it.

value.title: Chi Tastes Food
value.synopsis: Ms. Yamada gets Youhei's Birthday party ready and hopes Chi doesn't ruin it.

value.title: Chi Causes Chaos
value.synopsis: Youhei's Birthday party begins and Chi is frightened of Youhei's present.

value.title: Chi Celebrates
value.synopsis: Youhei's Birthday party ends and Mr. Yamada has the new pictures developed. The Yamadas realize that it's the first birthday that Chi has ever been to.

value.title: Chi Walks Around
value.synopsis: Chi goes out of her yard again and chases a butterfly. Chi wanders off again, this time to an arcade street.

value.title: Chi Hears A Story
value.synopsis: Chi is rescued by a cat with a ribbon around its neck named Tama, and Tama keeps telling Chi to be careful.

value.title: Chi Makes Her Debut
value.synopsis: Chi follows Tama to a cat meeting for the first time to meet other cats, including the elder cat Fuji-San.

value.title: Chi Looks To The Sky
value.synopsis: The cat meeting begins, and Fuji-San just says comforting things to the cats.

value.title: Chi Is Warmly Welcomed
value.synopsis: Chi visits Ijyuin's place to see Alice.

value.title: Chi Gets Washed
value.synopsis: Mrs. Yamada takes Chi to a pet salon for the first time with Ijyuin and Alice.

value.title: Chi Gets Opened
value.synopsis: Mr. Yamada tries to open Chi's mouth to brush her teeth.

value.title: Chi Brushes Her Teeth
value.synopsis: Mr. Yamada buys stuff from the pet store and again tries to brush Chi's teeth.

value.title: Chi Gets Tested
value.synopsis: The Yamadas want to go on a trip but are afraid that Chi can't come, so Mr. Yamada and Youhei take Chi to ride a bus first.

value.title: Chi Rides
value.synopsis: The Yamadas want to go on a trip with Chi and so they decide to get a car.

value.title: Chi Drives
value.synopsis: The Yamadas drive their new car around the neighborhood with Chi.

value.title: Chi Goes Home
value.synopsis: Mr. Yamada is getting used to driving, and they go to a drive-through to get lunch. Then Chi gets out through the window.

value.title: Chi Rolls
value.synopsis: The Yamadas decide to go play tennis while Chi plays with tennis balls.

value.title: Chi Runs About
value.synopsis: Mr. and Mrs. Yamada plays tennis with each other and Chi wants to play with the tennis ball.

value.title: Chi Dives
value.synopsis: Chi goes to Fuji-San's house.

value.title: Chi Gets Admired
value.synopsis: Chi is carried to the cat meeting by Fuji-San and then David scares the other cats.

value.title: Chi Trims The Bamboo Tree
value.synopsis: The Tanabata (Bamboo) Festival comes and the Yamadas get a bamboo tree to decorate , but Chi comes back home.

value.title: Chi Wishes Upon A Star
value.synopsis: Since the bamboo tree is ruined, the Yamadas use a Christmas tree instead, and Youhei makes a wish.

value.title: Chi Gets Drenched
value.synopsis: Chi goes out, and then it rains.

value.title: Chi Is Sucked Up
value.synopsis: Mrs. Yamada tries to vacuum the house, but Chi doesn't want to move.

value.title: Chi Is In Sync
value.synopsis: Chi and Youhei are in sync together.

value.title: Chi Overcomes
value.synopsis: Youhei and Chi are home alone.

value.title: Chi Is Treated
value.synopsis: Tama and Alice argue about whose food is better, and Chi acts as the judge.

value.title: Chi Is Followed
value.synopsis: Tama and Alice keep and eye on Chi. As the argue, she wanders off.

value.title: Chi Is Discovered
value.synopsis: Chi wanders away and learns how to climb a tree, but can't get down.

value.title: Chi Goes Down
value.synopsis: Chi is stuck in a tree and Ryu rescues Chi to overcome his fear.

value.title: Chi Scoops
value.synopsis: Summer has come and the Yamadas plan to have nagashi-soumen, which is noodles eaten straight from water flowing through little bamboo canals.

value.title: Chi Gets Taken Away
value.synopsis: The Summer Festival has come and it is Chi's first time with Tama.

value.title: Chi Experiences
value.synopsis: Chi gets to experience the Summer Festival with Tama.

value.title: Chi Looks Up
value.synopsis: Chi and Tama have a good time at the Summer Festival. Chi is found by the Yamadas and looks surprised at the fireworks.

value.title: Chi Becomes Popular
value.synopsis: Mr. and Mrs. Yamada compete as to who understands Chi the best.

value.title: Chi Leaps
value.synopsis: Ms. Yamada buys Youhei a balloon.

value.title: Chi Boasts
value.synopsis: Chi follows the dog David, and shows off that she can go anywhere.

value.title: Chi Falls
value.synopsis: Chi gets trapped in a garbage can and can't get out.

value.title: Chi Crosses the Sea
value.synopsis: The Yamadas and Chi are going to Hokkaido to visit Juri and her family. They take Chi along for the cruise but Chi has to stay in a cage.

value.title: Chi Travels Around in Hokkaido
value.synopsis: The Yamadas and Chi arrive in Hokkaido and are headed to Juri and her family's ranch.

value.title: Chi Rides a Horse
value.synopsis: Juri shows Youhei and Chi the horses. Youhei rides together with Juri on a pony while Chi on the other hand has a different ride.

value.title: Chi Scares People
value.synopsis: It's bedtime for Youhei and Juri, but Youhei gets scared when Juri says that there are monsters.

value.title: Chi Gets Surrounded
value.synopsis: It's early morning, and the morning crowing from the rooster wakes Chi up. Chi finds herself some prey, and trouble.

value.title: Chi Meets a Cow
value.synopsis: Juri shows Youhei and Chi the barn where they milk cows.

value.title: Chi Looks at the Stars
value.synopsis: It is the last day that the Yamadas and Chi are staying. Juri decides to show Youhei and Chi her treasure.

value.title: Chi Meets a Red Fox
value.synopsis: The Yamadas and Chi finally leave the ranch, but then stop at a sunflower field and decide to take a picture. But then Chi follows a butterfly and meets a Northern Fox.

value.title: Chi Chaperones
value.synopsis: Mr. Yamada has to work and can't play with Chi; But Chi always cause trouble and can't stay still.

value.title: Chi Plays in the Garden
value.synopsis: Kusano Yuki comes over to the Yamadas to play with David. Chi tries to play with David in the yard.

value.title: Chi is Shown Gratitude
value.synopsis: The pet store lady comes to visit Chi and brings her some pet clothes. When Chi runs away from the pet store lady's dress-up session, Chi finds Youhei with Mrs. Yamada, playing with Mayu and Ryu. When the pet store lady finds her, there's a surprise.

value.title: Chi Goes Together
value.synopsis: Chi is going to the cat meeting and Alice comes along and tries to fit in.

value.title: Chi is Involved
value.synopsis: Chi's favorite toy is worn out and Ms. Yamada tries to make a homemade toy for Chi to play with.

value.title: Chi Has a Conversation
value.synopsis: Mr. Yamada is late for an important meeting, but in his haste, unknowingly takes Chi along.

value.title: Chi Performs Music
value.synopsis: Youhei practices the piano for school and Chi wants to play too.

value.title: Chi Plants Seeds
value.synopsis: The Yamadas decided to plant some flowers and Chi wants to play in their newly made garden.

value.title: Chi is Mistaken
value.synopsis: Chi remembers her first friend, the big black cat.

value.title: Chi is in a Hurry
value.synopsis: Chi mistakenly gets into a pickup truck and goes out of town. Chi is lost and can't get home.

value.title: Chi Gets Surrounded
value.synopsis: Chi couldn't find her way home but finds some company led by Tiger.

value.title: Chi Stays
value.synopsis: Chi sleeps at Tiger and his friend's place but wants to go home.

value.title: Chi Conveys a Message
value.synopsis: Chi is on her way home until she meets Tama's little sister, Hana.

value.title: Chi Advances
value.synopsis: Chi tries following the sun to find home, but encounters many obstacles. Everyone including the Yamadas continue looking for Chi.

value.title: Chi Collapses
value.synopsis: Chi still can't find her way home and collapsed with exhaustion. The Yamadas have not yet given up searching for Chi.

value.title: Chi Meets Again
value.synopsis: Chi meets the big black cat again.

value.title: Chi is Happy
value.synopsis: Chi travels with the big black cat.

value.title: Chi Renews her Promise
value.synopsis: Chi finds her way home and made a promise with the big black cat.

value.title: Chi Runs
value.synopsis: The Yamadas go to the place where they first found Chi, and find Chi again.

value.title: Chi Makes a Family
value.synopsis: Chi finally returns home and so everyone holds a party for her. Everyone there is her family.
